reason: WaitingFor::ChooseGiftRecipient gains a purpose (CastOpponentChoicePurpose: Gift or EffectCost) so an effect-cost recipient prompt such as Invigorate's is not presented as a gift promise. An older full-game or P2P peer would read an EffectCost prompt as a Gift. PendingCast also gains deferred_life_gain_cost, the life-gain cost carried to the payment commit, which an older peer would drop. The Owed state of that cost carries the outcomes already staged through replacement (staged: surviving gains plus gains a cross-event substitute replaced, each with its held continuation) and the recipient parked on a replacement choice (paused_on), so each-other-player gains and their substitutes settle simultaneously; an older peer would drop both and apply the gains one at a time.
